title: More pictured details on six early Chicago buildings
items: The infant school has larger openings and a log gable; Cobweb Castle has a reconstructed compound; Miller House has boarded upper walls; Carpenter’s shop has taller sash and a chimney; Wolf Point has rounded logs, recessed entries and a sign pole. Sources distinguish pictured details from reconstructed dimensions, and the image comparisons remain open.
The first Tremont House has a darker reconstructed roof following the Gifford drawing. Cards explain historical review context while retaining the recorded flags, reasons and sources.
